The new atomic component interprets these same schemes and quantifies net bonding as bond order; this is a didactic operationalization, not a literal source quotation or an independent approval. No claim is made for RP or other jurisdictions.

derivedOperationalization: Balance bonding and antibonding orbital occupancy in the explicitly taught MO schemes to quantify the same binding relationships and support the prescribed existence inference. No new molecular family, model, or comparative-stability topic is introduced.
